scope: Bounded source review after Probe49; not a proof of full behavioral equivalence

checks.finding: Linux probe_finalize also asserts DWC3 reset, powers inherited PHY state down, then selects dummy PIPE mux. No missing bootstrap step established.
The inspected M1 power-up, post-tunable, clock, lane and reset-release sequence is represented in the prototype. This manual review does not establish all timing equivalence.
Linux USB4 path applies RX-detect override, lock, mux change, removes override and unlocks. Prototype already implements these, and the delayed placement was tested earlier.

Linux waits for endpoint map and IOP power acknowledgement then sets AP ON. Prototype boot waits for IOP ON and caller explicitly waits for AP ON before firmware-ready/tunables. No omitted AP ON established.

Input lists and selected final register values do not cover every transient state, timing or inherited cable/peer condition. U-Boot polls firmware messages while Linux processes them asynchronously; causal significance not established.
